description: Pre-registered mixed-difficulty pilot: 3 low-uncertainty controls and 2 multi-module diagnostic tasks; no selected winner.

tasks.prompt: Fix subtitle_filter_path: Windows-style drive-colon paths must escape the colon with a backslash for the filter expression, while path separators become forward slashes. Preserve POSIX paths.
Our measured TTS speaking rate is 5.0 characters/second, not 6.5. Fix estimate_seconds to use this observed rate; it must not alter other behavior.
Check whether clips_duration already sums all clip lengths correctly. If it does, do not modify anything.

Production incident: tenants disagree about a feature rollout. An API sometimes returns another tenant's flag value, but each tenant's source configuration is correct. Investigate backend reads, cache behavior and service wiring; repair the root cause. Preserve TTL expiration, false-valued cache entries and backend read efficiency. Do not disable caching. Verify with existing tests.

Video pipeline incident: individual renders succeed, but after resuming an interrupted daily news job the output timeline sometimes repeats one clip and silently loses a different clip with the same display title. Investigate segment metadata, manifest keys and the timeline builder. Preserve already-completed renders across retries, render each distinct segment only once after success, keep the caller's order, and never mark a failed render complete.
